scope: Exploratory T3 diagnosis on eight already-exposed first600-second windows; no fresh V4 outcome or raw tail access. All failures retained; no confirmatory inference.

original_receipt.scope: POST HOC exploratory T3 only: all eight previously exposed sessions; no confirmatory inference.
original_receipt.fit: mean-loss ridge; prefix-only all-observation mean/std, floors TX .1 SBP .01; common 62-bin/block training burn; feature clip8; unit-disk output; no mask in filtering
original_receipt.intercept_shrink_definition: Multiply the fitted standardized-feature intercept; post-hoc deployment-available rule, no evaluator labels used in transform.
original_receipt.sbp_recenter_definition: Optionally subtract each current logSBP vector's channel mean, then subtract a per-channel 5s EW mean from PREVIOUS bins (initialize to first observed vector at each block); update baseline with current bin only after subtraction; apply .2s fast filter afterward.
